rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for someone's natural ability to learn or do something.

example.english: They have a real aptitude for drawing; after just a few lessons, they get it.
example.traditional: 佢學畫畫好有天份，教幾次就識。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hok6 waa2 waa2 hou2 jau5 tin1 fan6 gaau3 gei2 ci3 zau6 sik1

rows.note: Use this more formal word when discussing a person's innate qualities or suitability for academic or professional training.

example.english: Given their academic results and analytical skills, they have the aptitude to study law.
example.traditional: 以佢嘅學業成績同分析能力，佢具備修讀法律嘅資質。
example.jyutping: ji5 keoi5 ge3 hok6 jip6 sing4 zik1 tung4 fan1 sik1 nang4 lik6 keoi5 geoi6 bei6 sau1 duk6 faat3 leot6 ge3 zi1 zat1
